title: Great save: Fairclough denies Varga's 24 m free kick

plan.angle: Fairclough's superb save from Varga's 24 m free kick keeps the game level.

lines: What a stop! Varga’s left‑foot blast from 24 m on target at 97 km/h — Fairclough threw himself and palmed it away.
That tiny 0.01 xG was still dangerous; Fairclough denied a potential 63.4‑point swing with that parry.
He’s up to four saves and keeps it level; before the stop the home win chance was about 27%.

brief.headline: Fairclough palms away Varga’s 24 m free kick to keep it 1-1

facts.statement: Varga struck a left‑foot free kick from 24.05 metres that was on target.
The shot left the boot at 96.9 km/h.
The chance had an xG of 0.0096.
The moment carried a potential swing labelled 63.4 points.
Fairclough has four saves in the match including this one.
Match win probabilities before/after the moment were 26.53% home, 49.23% draw, 24.24% away.

brief.insight: Varga chose a powerful, on‑target left‑foot free kick from distance; Fairclough read the flight and made a high‑quality save to parry it away. That decision to hit powerfully rather than curl wide forced the keeper into a decisive, game‑leveling intervention and prevented a large expected momentum swing.
